ranked.headline: Machine learning links molecular and clinical features to predicted cancer drug response
ranked.summary: scDrugMap benchmarks foundation models across 495,000 cells while GDSC-based fusion models predict kinase inhibitor sensitivity in cell lines.

ranked.headline: Biological priors shape embeddings for single-cell, spatial, and clinical omics
ranked.summary: Foundation models and generative methods now extend constrained representations from scRNA-seq to histology, spatial omics, and longitudinal transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: ML drug discovery models add explicit uncertainty and error control to predictions
ranked.summary: Screening and ADMET decisions increasingly depend on calibrated confidence rather than point predictions alone.

ranked.headline: Residue-resolved energetics and side-chain flexibility in ligand recognition
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2025 GPCR study apply flexible docking, perturbation scanning, and graph learning to assign binding determinants at residue level.

ranked.headline: Inference frameworks link gut microbes and metabolites to host and disease outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package double machine learning, penalized regression and graph neural networks into R tools for microbiome multi-omics.

ranked.headline: Assemblies link genome architecture to size, rearrangement and structural variation
ranked.summary: Near-chromosome-level assemblies across brown algae, planarians, termites, amniotes and scrub-jays now resolve architecture against evolutionary drivers.

ranked.headline: Computational methods trace atoms, stereochemistry and assembly complexity in metabolites
ranked.summary: Exact scalable assembly-index analysis and stereochemistry-aware metabolite assignment are now benchmarked on large natural product and control sets.

ranked.headline: Software tools for benchmarking, standardising and visualising omics analysis outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published R/Bioconductor package extend software for evaluating, validating and interpreting omics analysis outputs.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations define state ensembles for chromatin and DEAD-box proteins
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and enhanced-sampling simulations now parameterize conformational ensembles across several systems, with some constrained by measured data.

ranked.headline: Task-specific k-mer, minimizer, and graph indexing for pangenome and ancient DNA
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply compact k-mer, minimizer, and graph primitives to pangenome alignment, variant description, and sketch-based mapping.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods link genetic regulation and cell communication to disease biology
ranked.summary: Atlas-scale single-cell datasets, such as a 222-donor lung eQTL map and a 16M-cell communication reference, now support cell-type-resolved inference.

ranked.headline: Curated data and generative models steer conditional design of proteins and molecules
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a December 2025 publication report generative models conditioned on curated data, filters, or structure for protein and molecule design.

ranked.headline: Learned models for cell segmentation, classification, and super-resolution imaging
ranked.summary: Learned models in cell microscopy increasingly aim to reduce dependence on manual annotation through synthetic data, foundation models, and self-supervision.

ranked.headline: Learned latent representations decode fMRI, iEEG, LFP and multiscale neural activity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply self-supervised, distillation and dynamical latent models to fMRI, intracranial and spiking-field recordings.

ranked.headline: Haplotype and recombination structure encoded in genomic analysis software
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale genotype data now demand haplotype and crossover representations that scale to association, imputation, and simulation workflows.

ranked.headline: Transcriptomic and multi-omic models predicting therapeutic response across tissues
ranked.summary: Single-cell and bulk RNA-seq profiles are increasingly paired with ML and algorithmic models to stratify patients and prioritize therapeutic targets.

ranked.headline: LLM agents direct bioinformatics tools for scRNA-seq annotation and NGS interpretation
ranked.summary: LLM agents are now applied to NGS downstream analysis and scRNA-seq cell annotation, with CASSIA the lone published example in this set.

ranked.headline: Augmenting scarce labeled peptide data with generative models for classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative augmentation with Transformers for peptide tasks, while a training-free hash embedding matches LoRA-tuned ESM-2.

ranked.headline: Transparent method design choices in free energy, residence time, and docking workflows
ranked.summary: Recent GPCR, residence-time, parametrization, and torsion studies each treat method components as explicit, reportable elements of their results.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence embeddings with ensemble heads predict genomic and protein sites
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply pretrained genomic and protein language models to RNA, promoter, glycation, and ion channel prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models chart bacterial metabolism and gene function across strains
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply genome-scale models and comparative genomics to strain-level bacterial metabolism and gene function.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link connectivity, plasticity, and neural responses
ranked.summary: Connectome and biology-constrained models are now benchmarked quantitatively against neural data, spanning fly vision and recurrent learning rules.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks assess generalizability of perturbation response models across datasets
ranked.summary: Perturbation datasets now span single-cell CRISPR screens and in vitro-to-in vivo comparisons, prompting systematic tests of model transportability.

ranked.headline: GWAS loci are translated into genes, cell types, and shared genomic factors
ranked.summary: Large GWAS and rare-variant datasets now support gene-, cell-type-, and factor-level interpretation across multiple disorders.

ranked.headline: Evidence beyond raw calls refines variant classification and mutational signatures
ranked.summary: Population frequencies, read-level heterozygosity and calling consensus are now shaping variant calls across long-read, short-read and tumour-only data.

ranked.headline: RBP binding links exon inclusion to histone marks and NMD efficiency in tumors
ranked.summary: Recent work couples RBP binding at exon flanks to chromatin marks while profiling NMD efficiency and splicing in tumors at single-cell and bulk resolution.

ranked.headline: Known-truth simulators and benchmarks expose limits of sequencing analysis tools
ranked.summary: Ground-truth simulation is now used to benchmark mosaic, long-read, hybridization, and nanopore modification tools under controlled conditions.

ranked.headline: In silico screen and cross-species genomics link regulators to chromatin and G4 potential
ranked.summary: Computational screens and cross-species analyses now link regulatory factors to chromatin architecture, mutation bias, and trait-associated expression.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked feature scoring extends from bulk expression to isoform and chromatin data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints score or benchmark molecular features against defined reference datasets across RNA-seq, single-cell, chromatin, and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Genomic architecture and chromatin dynamics underlying plant abiotic stress responses
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved T2T assembly, population scans, and HSFA1 chromatin profiling now address stress-response genomics across species.

ranked.headline: Predictor reliability varies for disordered multimers and amyloid polymorphs
ranked.summary: Preprints from December 2025 benchmark AlphaFold3 and peers beyond ordered globular domains, testing disorder, amyloid polymorphs and nanobody-ligand complexes.

ranked.headline: Learned estimators recover structure from noisy single-cell and spatial expression data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs new estimators for batch correction, denoising and spatial modeling with benchmarks against established tools.

ranked.headline: Methods sharpen cell-type resolution in single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analysis
ranked.summary: Cell-state-resolved analysis demands robust handling of batch effects, spatial QC, replicates and normalisation in single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Learned samplers are validated against physical energies and free-energy landscapes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test whether learned and enhanced-sampling methods reproduce physically meaningful conformational behavior.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of protein localization and secretory pathway regulation
ranked.summary: Open-source computational models now infer protein localization and secretory mechanisms from spatial and omics data.

ranked.headline: Methods partition genetic, regulatory and interaction effects on complex traits
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale datasets now allow testing epistasis, co-expression and gene-environment effects beyond marginal single-trait association.

ranked.headline: Learned and sparse models infer nonlinear fitness landscapes and population dynamics
ranked.summary: Data-driven inference of population and fitness models is now being checked against curated landscapes and interpretable summary statistics.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative design extends to nucleases and antibody repertoires
ranked.summary: Structure-conditioned design now targets nuclease scaffolds and antibody binding and developability objectives, not only catalytic function.

ranked.headline: Computational neoantigen prioritization for immunotherapy response and off-target risk
ranked.summary: Neoantigen vaccine trials and checkpoint blockade studies need reproducible, prioritized candidate lists that account for HLA context and cross-reactivity.

ranked.headline: Neural networks constrained by mechanistic structure fit pathway and trajectory dynamics
ranked.summary: Pairing neural function approximation with explicit ODE or reaction-network form is being tested across metabolic, chemical, and single-cell dynamics.
